text:
Aisha Khan: Quick heads-up — kicking off a sandbox sweep probe on crm-staging to find ghost contacts and mis-tagged accounts. Dry-run playbook id `pb-sweep-v9`. Timeline: probe now -> 1h sampling -> optional rollforward. @Marcus Lee @Priya Patel :wave:
Marcus Lee: sgtm. what's the sample size? will this touch prod?
Aisha Khan: sampling 2% of accounts (random seed 42) in staging only. won't hit prod — using crm-staging replica + read-only hooks. Playbook will output candidate csv to s3://redwood-ci/cs-sandbox/1799876543.csv and will NOT modify records.
Priya Patel: nice. please include the healthscore distribution pivot per segment and ping when the CSV is up :eyes:
Tobias Müller: can playbook-bot run validation on candidate set to check idempotency and detect previously corrected rows? if yes, mark for skip. also check merged-account tokens.
Playbook Bot: `pb-sweep-v9` dry-run started by Aisha Khan — writing candidates to s3 (approx ~4.2k). running validation stage now.
Playbook Bot: validation complete: 4,200 total candidates, 720 flagged as "skip" (already corrected / recent activity), 3,480 new candidates. sample csv: s3://redwood-ci/cs-sandbox/1799876543-sample.csv
Marcus Lee: can you paste the healthscore pivot snapshot here? quick numbers ok.
Aisha Khan: Healthscore pivot (segment | avg | median | pct_below_30):
- SMB: avg 62 | median 65 | pct_below_30 4%
- Mid-Market: avg 51 | median 49 | pct_below_30 9%
- Enterprise: avg 70 | median 73 | pct_below_30 2%
I'll attach full pivot in the sheet.
Priya Patel: looks reasonable. curious about the 9% in mid-market — any pattern with onboarding_status=stalled?
Aisha Khan: yes — ~68% of mid-market accounts below 30 have onboarding_status "stalled". 44% also missing `quarterly_touchpoint` field.
Marcus Lee: OK to run targeted enrichment on the sample (nudge email + create task for rep) or keep sweep read-only?
Priya Patel: keep it read-only for now. we should validate playbook rules for send-email to avoid duplicates. after we confirm FP rate we can propose an enrichment run with opt-out.
Aisha Khan: agreed. next step: post dry-run we'll do a 20-min decision sync in #customer-success. proposal: if false-positive rate <10% we schedule rollforward Tue 04:00 UTC. objections?
Tobias Müller: no objections. i'll run the idempotency test script against the candidate CSV and post a diff.
Playbook Bot: idempotency test complete. rerun stability: 99.1% unchanged. heuristic FP estimate: 7.8%.
Aisha Khan: perfect. uploading sample CSV + short runbook to drive now. link: https://drive.redwood/team/cs/sandbox/1799876543 (contains sample, pivot, runbook, rollback steps).
Marcus Lee: thanks. @Priya Patel @Tobias Müller if you can review tonight we can confirm rollforward tomorrow.
Priya Patel: :thumbsup: will review and leave comments in the sheet.
Tobias Müller: done — left 3 comments re: merged accounts, missing external_crm_id, and one edgecase on touchpoint timestamps.
Aisha Khan: thanks all. i'll close this thread once rollforward is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
